draft.shortGloss: to fall; to set; to fail; to fish
draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and observational, noting an everyday occurrence
notes: Used in many everyday expressions: ฝนตก (fǒn tòk, 'it rains'), สอบตก (sɔ̀ɔp tòk, 'to fail an exam'), ตกใจ (tòk-jai, 'to be startled'), and ตกปลา (tòk plaa, 'to fish').

senses.definition: To drop or come down from a higher position, including rain or snow.

examples.text: ฝนตกหนักมาก
ใบไม้ตกจากต้นไม้
examples.translation: The leaves fall from the tree.
examples.emotion: calm and quiet, watching leaves drift down in a gentle breeze

senses.definition: Of the sun or moon: to go down below the horizon.

examples.text: พระอาทิตย์ตกดินแล้ว
examples.emotion: peaceful and reflective at the end of a long day

senses.definition: To not pass an exam or subject (often after สอบ, 'to take an exam').

examples.text: เขาสอบตกวิชาภาษาไทย
examples.translation: He failed the Thai language exam.

senses.definition: To catch fish or other aquatic animals with a hook and line.

examples.text: พ่อชอบไปตกปลาวันอาทิตย์
examples.translation: Dad likes to go fishing on Sundays.

draftBefore.shortGloss: to fall; to drop; to set (sun)
draftBefore.emotion: matter-of-fact and observational, noting an everyday occurrence
notes: ตก is extremely versatile. Beyond physical falling, it is used for celestial bodies setting (sun, moon), failing an exam, and catching fish or rain.

senses.definition: To drop or fall down to the ground from a higher position.

examples.text: ใบไม้ตกจากต้นไม้
examples.translation: The leaves fall from the tree.
examples.emotion: calm and quiet, watching leaves drift down in a gentle breeze

senses.definition: To set, as the sun or the moon going down below the horizon.

examples.text: พระอาทิตย์ตกดินแล้ว
examples.emotion: peaceful and reflective at the end of a long day

senses.definition: To fail an exam or a test.

examples.text: เขาตกสอบภาษาไทย
examples.translation: He failed the Thai language test.
examples.emotion: disappointed and discouraged about the bad result

faults.quote: เขาตกสอบภาษาไทย
faults.why: Ungrammatical word order; in Thai 'to fail an exam' is สอบตก, not ตกสอบ.
ตก does not mean 'catching rain'; ฝนตก means 'rain falls' (it rains).
